user.title: Connect to pi-voice
user.description: The URL where the pi-voice agent listens, for example http://192.168.0.33:8787.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach pi-voice at that URL.

abort.already_configured: This pi-voice agent is already configured.

data_description.prompt: Sent to the agent as standing instructions; the agent keeps its own persona and memory.
data_description.handoff_after: If the agent hasn't answered by then, the satellite says it is working on it and announces the answer later. Assist cancels turns at about 30 seconds.
data_description.timeout: How long a handed-off request may run in total.
